name: Tác (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tác: a blue and yellow shield with a column, ears of grain and a wavy band inscribed TÁC, within a yellow rope border.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
